outcome: Torsional autoamputated hemorrhagic necrotic tuba-ovarian cyst
Abdominal ascites due to rupture of neonatal ovarian cyst
cohort: The study describes four infants presenting with uncommon complications of antenatal ovarian cysts.
finding: The case series illustrates a spectrum of uncommon complications of antenatal ovarian cysts, including autoamputation, torsion, and rupture with ascites, emphasizing the therapeutic dilemma in deciding between surgical and conservative management.
